observations.lettering: Korean is legible in 360px views. Balloons stay fixed; tails indicate the intended speaker. First dialogue is visible at zero seconds.

observations.motion: 100 to 103 percent uniform zoom. No blank edges or essential-face/dialogue crop observed at shot start, middle and end.

observations.cover: Separate 1080x1920 cover with 이게 한 끼라고? and 장고랑 살아보니 07. Title and central character survive inspected 3:4 crop.
observations.fit: Native 941x1672 uniformly fits 1080x1920 with less than one native background pixel cropped; no nonuniform stretching.
